questions.question: What did Nehemiah ask King Artaxerxes for?
options: To be sent to Judah to rebuild the city
An army to defend the province
A great gift of gold from the royal treasury
Freedom for all the Jewish exiles
questions.answer: To be sent to Judah to rebuild the city

questions.question: What did Nehemiah do first when he arrived in Jerusalem?
options: Began building the walls at once
Held a feast for the leaders
Called the whole city to assemble
